get.description: Available in API-driven standalone mode, with the YAML configuration provider and Admin API enabled. Returns the accepted configuration snapshot and its version and digest metadata, not a worker synchronization report. See [API-Driven Standalone Mode Usage](/apisix/reference/api-standalone-usage).

put.description: Replace the complete configuration snapshot in API-driven standalone mode. Omitted resources are removed unless their resource type's configuration version is explicitly retained. Validate the complete document before applying it. A client-supplied `X-Digest` is required and must change when the intended configuration changes. APISIX compares the supplied identifier, not a computed hash. A matching digest skips the update and any wait. APISIX supports an optional bounded `wait` for local worker synchronization; this does not verify other instances or upstream health. See [API-Driven Standalone Mode Usage](/apisix/reference/api-standalone-usage).

200.description: With a positive wait, all local workers reported the submitted digest for their tracked HTTP and enabled stream resource types.

202.description: Snapshot accepted. No wait was requested, or the wait expired before local worker synchronization was confirmed. A timeout does not roll back the snapshot.

204.description: The supplied digest matches the stored snapshot. No update or wait was performed; this is not a readiness confirmation.

parameters.name: X-Digest
parameters.description: Client-chosen identifier for this snapshot. Use a new value for changed content.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait timeout in milliseconds. Values above 60000 are capped; absent, nonnumeric, or nonpositive values do not wait.

head.description: Returns `200 OK` when the API-driven standalone configuration endpoint is reachable, including before any snapshot is loaded. When available, digest and last-modified metadata are returned in headers. This endpoint does not confirm worker synchronization.
